pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.modelHIRE: Hall hire — one price for the event
pricing.modelHelp: Wedding halls usually charge a hall hire, a per-guest menu, or both. Starting from is what guests see on cards.
pricing.sectionHint: Set a public starting price, then add Gold/Silver packages if food is billed per person.
pricing.editHint: Save the hall details and a starting price. Packages below handle per-guest menus.
pricing.startingHelp: Shown on venue cards as “from”. Bookings use this when no package is selected.
pricing.packageHint: Use Event for hall hire. Use Per guest for catering/menu with a minimum headcount.
pricing.noPackages: No packages yet. Add a hall-hire or per-guest menu so bookings have a real amount.
pricing.hireHint: Guests pay one hall hire for the date, regardless of headcount.
pricing.perGuestHint: The quote is price × guests, never below the minimum guest count.
pricing.hybridHint: Starting from is the public floor. Packages can mix hall hire and per-guest menus.

staff.passwordOptional: Leave blank to keep the current password

staff.inviteSent: Invite emailed with a temporary password

settings.currencyHint: Fallback only when a record has no country. UAE uses AED and Saudi uses SAR automatically.

finance.superSubtitle: Set HQ commission on each country desk’s income. Country admins set vendor rates.
finance.countrySubtitle: Set the commission you charge your vendors. HQ share of your income is locked by super admin.
finance.superHero: HQ commission from each country desk, collected cash, and marketplace volume — never mixed across currencies.
finance.countryHero: Your vendor commission, HQ share, and desk earnings for this country.
finance.reportsSuper: HQ vs country-desk earnings, collected cash, and CSV export. Amounts stay in each desk’s currency.
finance.reportsCountry: Your desk P&L: vendor commission, HQ share, and what this country keeps.
